title: Re:zer0
description: Die, return, try again. When cursed by the Witch of Envy, death becomes a checkpoint that rewinds your body, inventory, and the world itself.
body:
Return by Death: Receiving the Cursed effect creates an automatic save point. On lethal damage, you instantly rewind with no respawn and no item drops. Restores health, hunger, XP, inventory, effects, and exact position.

World Rewind: Blocks you placed after the save point vanish. Blocks you broke are restored to their original state. Containers (chests, furnaces, brewing stands) are snapshotted when opened and restored on death, fully preventing duplication exploits.

Save Points: Auto-created when you get the Cursed effect, earn an advancement, sleep, or open a container.

Multiplayer: Fully per-player — one player's rewind does not affect others. World time rewinds for the dying player.

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
Inspired by Re:Zero − Starting Life in Another World.
